document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The sight of hideous, gigantic, fungoid, lobster-things laboring 
like rockhounds along the streambed wrenches an exclamation 
of  terror  from  your  party.  The  creatures  drop  their  mineral 
gathering tools and reach for twisted silvery objects, which just 
might be weapons.

Gain 1 point of Cthulhu Mythos. To flee, go to 476. To shoot it out 
with these horrors, go to 380.
